Attend an Information Session
Graduate Student Ambassadors
Graduate Student Ambassadors are current SCI graduate students who can provide a firsthand perspective on being a graduate student at the School of Computing and Information. They can answer questions about their student experience, academics, research, and life in Pittsburgh.
Note: While ambassadors can provide the student perspective, official graduate admissions questions should be directed to the Graduate Admissions Manager.
Brandon Danko
Hello! I'm Brandon and I'm a first-year master's student pursuing my Master's in Information Science, with a specialization in Human-Centered Computing (HCI) at SCI, where I also work as a course assistant to our MDS program. I previously graduated with a BS in Computer Science and worked in industry as a QA Lead. I love engaging in research on how to improve the status quo of social computing and AI usage. If you have any questions about SCI or Pittsburgh or just want to chat, please reach out!
